signedOut.title: Sign in to manage privacy
signedOut.body: Choose who can message you, what your profile shows, and who you've blocked.

allowDms.label: Allow direct messages
allowDms.helper: When off, you are hidden from search and people can't start new conversations with you. Existing chats stay open.

showHours.label: Show my service record
showHours.helper: When on, your public profile lists each event you were credited for - the date, the community and who credited it. When off, your total hours are hidden from your profile too, and you drop off community leaderboards.
